verdict.rationale: Ente provides a CLI (ente-cli) for exporting/backing up Auth codes and a documented deep-link scheme (enteauth://search), but there is no documented public REST/GraphQL API or SDK for driving the product programmatically — OpenAPI probes returned 404s. missing for 10: a documented public API/SDK covering core operations (add/edit/delete codes, sharing, sync), API authentication docs, and independent developer corroboration of API usage.
